modal.headline: Help Us Grow Our Club
modal.body: We would like to see who is interested to join the Youth 4 Elders community! Add your email if you're interested in helping grow our club and connecting generations.
modal.successMessage: We hope to see you soon! We'll be in touch with updates about Youth 4 Elders and upcoming events.

mission.description: A student-led club dedicated to bridging the gap between elders and youth in a fast-moving society. Created by passionate uOttawa students and community members, Youth 4 Elders connects generations through volunteering, workshops, and meaningful relationships.

updates.title: Website Now Live!
updates.description: Our new website is here! Explore our events, learn about our mission, and discover how you can get involved.

updates.title: Upcoming Event: Bingo Night
updates.description: Join us April 7, 2026 in the RGN Student Lounge—trivia, three rounds of bingo, and $30 FNS gift cards for round winners. Free spots are limited; check the countdown and register via the link in our bio.

updates.title: Tech Literacy at Glebe
updates.description: Our tech literacy workshop series has started again at The Glebe Centre as of January 16.

quote.text: Bridging generations, one connection at a time.

cards.title: Workshop Series
cards.description: A 6-week weekly workshop series teaching and helping with technology. Now running at The Glebe Centre.

cards.title: Krispy Kreme Fundraiser
cards.description: Y4E is hosting a fundraiser in collaboration with Discover Innovate Youth Network. Pay for a box to support the mission.

cards.title: Build a Bouquet
cards.description: Join us for a Valentine's Day workshop—pick your flowers and create a one-of-a-kind bouquet to take home or give to someone special.

getInvolved.description: Want to become a member? Connect with passionate students and caring elders as we build meaningful relationships that bring generations together.
